lesson: Zaporizhzhia was covered but dramatically underweighted. For short-horizon attack-location questions, recent target cadence and city-specific residential damage should outweigh broad priors based on overall national prominence.

The forecast overfit conflict-hotspot base rates in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. When wording points to paramilitary offices or an institutional gate, major headquarters cities such as Karachi need explicit coverage.

Recent attacker and offside signals obscured the set-piece path. For chaotic stoppage-time goals, retain aerial centre-backs such as Davinson Sanchez rather than limiting the slate to forwards and attacking full-backs.
